description:
About Luma

Luma’s mission is to build unified general intelligence that can generate, understand, and operate in the physical world.

We believe that multimodality is critical for intelligence. To go beyond language models and build more aware, capable and useful systems, the next step function change will come from vision. So, we are working on training and scaling up multimodal foundation models for systems that can see and understand, show and explain, and eventually interact with our world to effect change.

Where You Come In

We are looking for a hands-on generalist with impeccable taste and a strong, opinionated design perspective. This is not a role for hyper-specialists or managers. You will take ownership of projects and drive the design vision from a fuzzy concept to a polished, shipped feature with a high degree of autonomy. You will tackle the unique challenge of designing novel, intuitive interaction paradigms for an AI-native product, making abstract concepts feel tangible and magical.

We are open to both full-time and contract-to-hire candidates, depending on experience, mutual fit, and team needs.

At Luma, AI is not a feature we design around. It is how we work. We expect designers to think with AI, generate with AI, build with AI, and use it to accelerate everything from ideation to production. If you have already made this shift in how you work, you will thrive here.

- Own features end-to-end. Lead the design process for major features, from initial product thinking and user exploration to pixel-perfect visual design and high-fidelity interactive prototypes.
- Design novel interactions. Go beyond static screens. Design and prototype fluid, novel interactions for a new medium, taking complex AI concepts and making them feel intuitive and powerful.

- You are equally strong in craft and product thinking. You demonstrate excellence across visual design, interaction design, and product thinking.

DEI Statement 

Differences fuel the creative spirit.

At Nike Communications, we recognize that diversity, equity, and inclusion are critical components to our success, and we are deeply committed to creating a workplace that values and supports the unique talents and perspectives of every individual. We are passionate about building an agency that truly reflects the diversity of our world, and we firmly believe that fostering a culture of inclusivity and equity is a fundamental responsibility shared by everyone within our agency.

More About The Role

Join our team as a Junior Graphic Designer! This role will work with our many teams on their graphic design needs for current and potential clients, while also supporting design needs across the agency’s social media team.

Reducto is the agentic document platform for leading AI teams who demand enterprise performance at scale. We provide a comprehensive toolkit for working with documents the way a human would, combining custom in-house and leading frontier models to power efficient and accurate document workflows.

We’ve grown rapidly, increasing revenue 8x year over year and partnering with hundreds of companies, from leading AI teams like Harvey, Vanta, and Scale, to enterprise customers across FAANG and top trading firms.

Reducto has raised over $100M from world-class investors including a16z, Benchmark, and First Round Capital.

As an early member of our product design team you’ll shape the foundation of how users interact with our product—from core workflows to visual language. You’ll work directly with our CEO, engineers, and customers to design entirely new experiences. We don’t have PMs— so you’ll own design end-to-end: user research, UX flows, wireframes, high-fidelity mocks, and design systems.

- You are your own worst critic. You have a high bar for quality and don’t rest until the job is done right—no settling for 90%. We want someone who ships fast, with high agency, and who doesn't just voice problems but actively jumps in to fix them.

- You’re comfortable navigating ambiguity and defining structure where none exists.
- You move fast, but also care deeply about polish and craft.

The Core Work Will Include



- Lead design end-to-end for Reducto, owning everything from defining a world-class brand to shipping beautiful experiences that users love.
- Develop brand new products and user workflows.
- Build and own our design system, brand, and how we present ourselves to the world.
- Obsess over the small details, driving a culture that highly values design.

Bonus Points If You



- Have prior experience founding a company or building products at early stages
- Are ambitious and driven, and care a lot about doing great work with great people
- Keep up with the latest developments in ML/AI

- Unlimited PTO: We believe great work requires recharging.

- Reimbursed Transportation: Provide us with your receipts and we’ll take care of the costs

You’ll own the end-to-end design for proactive outreach, including notification surfaces, preference management, and the Connect tab which helps connect members with their care team anywhere and anytime through visit scheduling and messaging. As a Product Designer, you’ll collaborate with cross-functional teams to create intuitive, user-centered solutions from concept to execution, including user research, interaction/UI design, and prototypes that advance our member experience while driving key business goals.

We’re looking for designers that excel in the ability to simplify complex challenges into impactful user experiences, care deeply about the quality of their work, have a strong track-record of shipping impactful experiences, come with a growth mindset, and bring a genuine desire to learn about our members.

This is a high-impact role, at an especially exciting time in Hinge Health’s journey. Our business is thriving, our member base continues to grow, and the impact of this role can directly power our company to grow.

What You'll Accomplish



- Drive the ongoing design evolution for the Preference Center and Notifications Feed initiatives. 
- Own the UX for new nudges, and member communication recovery patterns.

title: Product Manager / Designer
description:
About The Role

We’re looking for a hybrid PM / Designer who can scope a problem, design a solution, ship the spec, and write the light code or prototype to prove it works. You’ll partner with engineering pods, run experiments, and own outcomes, not tickets. You’ll also manage and mentor the engineers in your pod.

About The Team

Turtles is a world-class team letting anyone turn their passion into a beloved marketplace, helping 29M shoppers find the things they’ll love. We’re one of the fastest-growing startups in the US and we’re hiring brilliant and exceptionally-driven people to join us. We have a lean, 60 person team where every person owns outcomes end-to-end, learns and grows incredibly quickly, and works with teammates who set high standards. Our culture is focused around rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

Turtles isn’t for everyone, and that’s intentional. If you’re energized by hard problems and big opportunities, you’ll thrive here. Our team is primarily split between our offices in NYC, Helsinki, and Hong Kong, with portions of our team also working remotely. We prefer in-person hires and indicate our preferred locations for each role, but please apply regardless of your location as we’re always looking for brilliant people to join. We’re excited to meet you.

Why this role matters

We don’t have separate PM and Design lanes; the highest-leverage people we’ve hired sit in the middle. The right person here will materially shape what gets built across product, with direct input on roadmap and shipping cadence.

What you’ll do



- Own a product surface end-to-end: research, design, spec, ship, measure.
- Pair with engineers daily; jump into Figma, code, or a doc as the problem demands.
- Run experiments and own the outcomes you commit to.
- Set the bar for product quality and craft inside your pod.
- Manage and mentor the engineers in your pod.

What we’re looking for



- 4+ years across product management and product design (or a similar hybrid).
- Comfortable in Figma; comfortable reading and writing light code.
- Strong taste; strong written communication.
- Track record of shipping consumer products end-to-end with measurable outcomes.
- Bias toward shipping over polishing slides.

Nice to have



- Experience in commerce or two-sided marketplaces.
- A portfolio of shipped consumer surfaces with measurable outcomes.

How we hire

Role

A short, focused process designed to respect your time. The specifics vary by role, but here’s the format we typically aim for:



- Intro call with a relevant team member or a founder (30 min).
- Working session: pair with a senior team member or a founder on a real product spec or design tradeoff, in Figma and prose (~60 min).
- Depending on the role, a paid half-day trial so we can see how you work with the team, and so you can see what the problems actually look like.
- Offer within 5 business days of the final round.

Turtles is an equal-opportunity employer.
